research_findings: The application lacked strict rate-limiting on server actions, specifically the `joinWaitlist` functionality, making it vulnerable to spam and potential database exhaustion.
The repository utilizes Upstash Redis and Ratelimit in other parts of the ecosystem, which provide a fast, edge-compatible solution for request throttling.
features_improved: Refactored the `joinWaitlist` server action (`src/app/actions/waitlist.ts`) to include IP-based rate limiting using Upstash.
new_features_added: Implemented an Upstash Redis-backed sliding window rate limiter (`src/lib/ratelimit.ts`) configured to allow 3 requests per 1 minute.
Added graceful degradation for the rate limiter, falling back to allowing requests if Upstash environment variables are not present.
next_steps_for_next_run: Audit other public-facing server actions (e.g., feedback submission, AI prompts) and apply the `ratelimit` utility where necessary.
Enhance telemetry to log when users hit the rate limit threshold for better visibility into potential attacks.
